scope: Two reports, including the joint Daskalopoulos-Mese report counted once.
source_method: Versioned report full texts and selected original theorem statements; see individual packets for reading and proof boundaries.

reports.speaker: Georgios Daskalopoulos and Chikako Mese
reports.title: Harmonic Maps in Singular Geometry and Rigidity
reports.license: CC BY 4.0, verified on arXiv HTML; attribution and adaptation notice retained on reference page
reports.question: 没有光滑切空间时，如何定义调和映射、控制奇点，并把能量极小化转成群作用和复结构的刚性？
reports.reading_scope: Read the full arXiv v1 TeX, sections 1–6 and bibliography. Cross-checked the original hyperbolic-building Theorems 1–3, Teichmuller rigidity Theorem 1.2, Sun Theorem 1.1, and BDDM v4 Theorem A and logarithmic-growth definitions. The SIAM chapter identity was checked, but the downloadable arXiv version is the actual reading base.

proof_scope.2J0A: Pointwise Bochner calculation uses the existing connection/curvature definitions and explicitly displays the commuted derivative identity; normalization is one half of Delta|du|^2.
proof_scope.2J0E: Definition and smooth normalization calculated; convergence and absolute continuity of metric Sobolev energy measures cited from Korevaar-Schoen.
proof_scope.2J0F: Metric Dirichlet existence and local Lipschitz regularity cited, not derived from compactness alone.
proof_scope.2J0G: General CAT(0) energy convexity cited. Euclidean identity proved to explain normalization.
proof_scope.2J0H: Fixed-boundary uniqueness fully deduced from cited convexity and the proved zero-boundary Poincare inequality; constant maps explicitly prevent an unconditional uniqueness claim.
proof_scope.2J0K: Energy dissipation proved; global Eells-Sampson existence and convergence subsequences cited with closed source and compact nonpositively curved target.
proof_scope.2J0M: Full frequency derivative via the Rellich vector field and boundary differentiation; no unproved singular-target monotonicity asserted.
proof_scope.2J0O: Locally finite Euclidean-building regularity and cutoff estimates are cited; no theorem for arbitrary NPC targets asserted.
proof_scope.2J0P: Full conditional cutoff/Fatou proof, with weighted derivative decay explicitly assumed instead of inferred merely from codimension.
proof_scope.2J0R: Gromov-Schoen constant-map theorem cited. Fixed point deduction proved. Does not invoke the nonnegative-Ricci vanishing theorem for negatively curved symmetric sources.
proof_scope.2J0V: Hyperbolic-building fixed point theorem cited with reduced action and higher-rank cocompactness; its analytic proof is not claimed reconstructed.
proof_scope.2J0Z: Completion point and non-local-compactness established by explicit path and separation estimates, with unwrapped real twist coordinate.
proof_scope.2J10: Christoffel, curvature and harmonic-equation coefficients calculated consistently for 4dr^2+r^6dtheta^2.
proof_scope.2J12: Sun's single-stratum theorem cited, with connected source.
proof_scope.2J13: Uses the interior-image specialization of the holomorphic rigidity theorem, avoiding a blanket strong-negative-curvature assertion on product boundary strata.
proof_scope.2J14: Angular energy lower bound derived from Cauchy-Schwarz and metric-Sobolev directional energy, with half-energy normalization.
proof_scope.2J16: BDDM Theorem A specialized to SL2 so the target can be concretely defined as a tree. Existence and asymptotic analysis remain cited inputs.
proof_scope.2J19: Vertex/edge construction and q+1 valence explained; connectedness/acyclicity cited from the elementary-divisor construction, not falsely labelled proved.

deferred: Complete Korevaar-Schoen compactness, trace, energy-measure and regularity proofs.
General DM-complex asymptotic-product axioms and their full regularity proof; only precise building cases are used for theorem statements.
Gromov-Schoen and hyperbolic-building superrigidity Bochner identities and global nonbranching arguments.
Full Teichmuller cotangent identification, Weil-Petersson curvature theory, Sun iteration and holomorphic rigidity proofs.
Mapping-class pseudo-Anosov/sufficiently-large existence branch and boundary-product holomorphic classification.
General semisimple-group BDDM construction, compatibility of curve sections, logarithmic symmetric-differential applications.
The present import provides linked definitions and complete selected elementary arguments, not a claim that every research theorem has a self-contained internal proof.

reports.speaker: John B. Etnyre
reports.title: Submanifolds in Contact Geometry
reports.copyright: 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM
reports.question: 接触条件怎样细化子流形与结的光滑分类，经典整数、接触同调、手术与形式嵌入又如何揭示环境接触结构的柔性和刚性？
reports.reading_scope: Read all mathematical sections 1–6 of submanifoldsV3.tex in the supplied complete arXiv source archive, checked the cited bibliography entries and the official SIAM report metadata and license, and compared selected precise statements with the primary papers listed in actual_reading. The integration covers selected three-dimensional knot and higher-dimensional embedding branches, not every classification theorem or a reconstruction of all research proofs.

proof_scope.2K01: Pullback of the exterior derivative and the symplectic-orthogonal dimension formula prove the isotropic bound; the canonical existing Legendrian definition is reused.
proof_scope.2K04: The contact wedge product, Reeb vector field and Legendrian first-jet graph are calculated directly.
proof_scope.2K05: Slope recovery and smooth lifting of the semicubical cusp are proved explicitly; generic-front classification is a cited local model.
proof_scope.2K06: Darboux is proved by matching the form and its differential at a point and applying the local Gray argument with flow control.
proof_scope.2K07: The Gray vector field, pullback differential equation and positive conformal factor are derived. Smooth ODE flow and Cartan formulas are linked existing inputs.
proof_scope.2K08: Independence of the Seifert surface is proved using integral homological intersection; the intersection formalism is an existing prerequisite.
proof_scope.2K09: Contact framing and the linking definition are given with null-homology hypotheses; independence and orientation reversal are explained.
proof_scope.2K0A: Rotation is defined with a Seifert surface and a positive trivialization; surface dependence is retained through the integral relative first Chern class.
proof_scope.2K0B: The extending-section requirement is explicit. Boundary twisting of two extending sections proves independence for a fixed surface.
proof_scope.2K0C: Front formulas are derived by cusp rotation and mixed-crossing counts, with the positive contact-plane frame fixed. The generic-front local models are cited.
proof_scope.2K0D: Numerical stabilization formulas follow from front counts. Their statement assumes a cooriented ambient structure and a null-homologous knot, and transports the Seifert surface. Moving the zigzag independently of its location remains a cited local-isotopy result.
proof_scope.2K0E: The positive push-off and sl = tb - rot are calculated from the jet model and relative framing addition; the Legendrian neighborhood theorem is a cited input.
proof_scope.2K0F: An overtwisted disk gives tb = 0 directly. The converse disk-adjustment equivalence is cited from three-dimensional overtwisted theory.
proof_scope.2K0G: Smoothness at the axis, the positive contact wedge coefficient, and the overtwisted boundary condition are checked explicitly.
proof_scope.2K0H: The transverse Bennequin–Eliashberg inequality is cited. The absolute-value Legendrian version and Seifert-genus bound are derived using both orientations.
proof_scope.2K0I: Eliashberg's overtwisted classification is cited with closedness, coorientation, and isotopy versus plane-field homotopy distinguished. Relative and parametric versions require the designated disk neighborhood.
proof_scope.2K0J: Eliashberg–Fraser uniqueness and destabilization are cited. An explicit standard unknot and the complete permitted integer range are calculated.
proof_scope.2K0K: Legendrian simplicity separates the image and fibers of the classical-invariant map. The stabilization cone is derived using both signs.
proof_scope.2K0L: Chekanov's non-simple pair and Fuchs–Tabachnikov stable equivalence are cited; the pair's complete linearized-homology computation is not reproduced.
proof_scope.2K0N: The polygon differential, grading convention, signs, and action-area identity are specified. The grading follows Etnyre's math/0306256v2 section 4.1: degree of the closed projective tangent-line path, with clockwise closure, modulo twice rotation; no additional minus-one or half factor. Finiteness, degree minus one, differential squared zero, and invariance are cited from Lemma 4.1 and Theorem 4.4. The algebraic implication partial(a)=1 implies zero homology is proved.
proof_scope.2K0O: Three-dimensional looseness is defined by the existence of an overtwisted disk in the complement, separately from Murphy's high-dimensional local definition.
proof_scope.2K0P: The conversion from contact to Seifert surgery coefficient is derived. Existence and uniqueness of the tight local extension for contact plus/minus one surgery are cited.
proof_scope.2K0Q: The Ding–Geiges presentation theorem is cited; a smooth surgery diagram alone is not used as its proof.
proof_scope.2K0R: The contact-form calculation, chosen-knot framing rotation, and plane-field homotopy are explicit. Tightness and non-contactomorphism for distinct integers are Giroux–Kanda inputs, not conclusions inferred from one chosen knot.
proof_scope.2K0S: Formal Legendrian data retain the full path of bundle monomorphisms from the differential to an isotropic terminal map.
proof_scope.2K0T: Murphy's normalized loose chart includes its relative size condition and the restriction to Legendrian dimension at least two.
proof_scope.2K0U: Murphy's existence and isotopy theorem is cited with closed connected source, looseness, and dimension restrictions.
proof_scope.2K0V: The isotropic surgery dimensions, conformal symplectic normal data, and inverse coisotropic sphere are specified. The pointwise coisotropic condition is distinguished from the full surgery neighborhood. The Conway–Etnyre presentation theorem is cited.
proof_scope.2K0W: Contactness of the unit cotangent bundle is proved by contracting symplectic volume with the radial field. Radial pullback proves independence from the metric.
proof_scope.2K0X: The conormal dimension and vanishing tautological form prove Legendrianity; knot isotopy gives conormal isotopy in the forward direction.
proof_scope.2K0Y: An explicit diffeomorphism to the sphere jet space is given, with inverse and exact contact-form pullback.
proof_scope.2K0Z: Shende and Ekholm–Ng–Shende completeness results are cited with meridian/longitude markings for oriented recovery. Unmarked recovery retains mirror/orientation ambiguity. Enhanced contact homology is not identified with ordinary knot contact homology.
proof_scope.2K10: Formal isocontact data include conformal symplecticity and coorientation, not just inclusion of the contact hyperplane.
proof_scope.2K11: Casals–Pancholi–Presas Theorem 2 is cited for source dimension at least three and ambient dimension at least five. It is an existence theorem in a given formal class; no parametric uniqueness or one-dimensional version is inferred.
proof_scope.2K12: Casals–Etnyre Theorem 1.1 is cited for embeddings of the standard unit cotangent sphere bundle in the standard contact sphere; the branched-cover distinction is described without claiming its analytic proof.
proof_scope.2K13: Chern additivity is derived from the symplectic splitting. Integral normal-bundle triviality is explicitly cited from Kasuya arXiv:1305.2423v1 Theorem 2.4, so torsion is retained; no zero-point count is used as a proof of the integral self-intersection formula.
proof_scope.2K14: The contact push-off formula uses p=-epsilon*u and yields a positive pullback epsilon*lambda. Metric and radius variation in a fixed jet neighborhood are explained. The Legendrian neighborhood theorem remains cited. Definition 3.1, rather than the formal-isotopy Lemma 3.4, is the construction reference.

deferred: The full characteristic-foliation proof of Bennequin–Eliashberg, convex-surface theory, Eliashberg's overtwisted classification and the Eliashberg–Fraser unknot classification remain precise cited inputs.
The Giroux–Kanda torus classification, Ding–Geiges surgery proof and high-dimensional Conway–Etnyre contact surgery construction are not reconstructed.
Chekanov's polygon compactification, the full proof of differential squared zero and stable-tame invariance, and the explicit non-simple pair computation are deferred.

Torus/twist/cable/satellite knot classifications, uniform thickness, connected sums, Legendrian link symmetries, lens-space and rational classical invariants are not expanded as separate atomic branches.
The report's fibered-knot characterization of contact structures, pseudo-Anosov input and detailed non-loose torus-knot classification require further prerequisites.
The section 5.4 future Seifert-space program is not converted into a proved theorem.
Murphy's wrinkling construction, the Legendrian Whitney trick, high-dimensional branched-cover rigidity and analytic filling obstructions remain cited research proofs.
Enhanced knot-contact-homology modules and products, the microlocal sheaf proof of conormal completeness and the recovery of peripheral group data are not developed in full.
The Legendrian neighborhood theorem and the integral normal Euler-class theorem are quoted; their full general topological proofs are not claimed internal.
Additional embedding classifications, arbitrary codimension h-principles and symplectic cobordism/cap applications are deferred.

source_errata: Bochner identity in report v1 is normalized inconsistently. New 2J0A uses half Delta|du|^2 with unit Hessian/Ricci/target-curvature coefficients.
Report frequency denominator displays distance rather than distance squared. The elementary frequency branch uses squared boundary values and is separately derived.
Report integration-by-parts display has incompatible signs. New cutoff proof uses integral psi Delta e = -integral grad psi dot grad e.
For model 4dr^2+r^6dtheta^2, direct calculation yields K=-3/(2r^2), radial equation Delta r=3r^5|grad theta|^2/4 and angular coefficient 6/r.
A negative-curvature target alone does not ensure homotopy/equivariant uniqueness: distinct constant maps are counterexamples. Only fixed-boundary uniqueness is asserted here.
The general DM regularity discussion in the report explicitly defers technical hypotheses to its cited monograph. New theorem statements are restricted to locally finite Euclidean buildings.
The hyperbolic-building rigidity statement is checked against the original paper, retaining a hyperbolic-building target rather than arbitrary NPC DM complex.
Logarithmic-growth constants are adjusted to energy with factor 1/2; annular reference radius R is retained to avoid a spurious constant in lower bounds.

source_errata.resolution: The displayed cone suppresses change of the rotation coordinate. The notes use (r+a-b,t-a-b), a,b nonnegative, directly derived from the two stabilization formulas.
The primary theorem's peripheral markings are explicit for oriented recovery; forgetting markings retains mirror/orientation ambiguity. Enhanced and ordinary knot contact homology are distinguished.
Definitions use the original conformally symplectic terminal condition and coorientation, and the codimension-two existence theorem excludes the one-dimensional source.
The local contact push-off is cited to Definition 3.1. Lemma 3.4 concerns formal isotopy and is not cited as a proof of arbitrary neighborhood-choice invariance.
The note cites Kasuya Theorem 2.4 for normal-bundle triviality; a signed zero count is not substituted for an integral Thom-class argument.

review.mathematical_scope: Explicit elementary proofs, precise cited analytic/theorem inputs, and dependency reuse; not complete proofs of all research results.
